tools.name: api_status
tools.description: Check the Elfa API key tier, credit usage and remaining requests, and confirm the API is reachable. Free. Call this first when a request fails with an auth or credit error.

tools.name: mentions
tools.description: Social mentions from X and Telegram. 1 credit per call. Returns engagement metrics and a link per post, not the post text. mode=top ranks one ticker's mentions by engagement. mode=search filters by keywords or by account. mode=news returns the token news feed.

mode.description: top needs ticker. search needs keywords or accountName. news is a feed and needs neither.

ticker.description: Ticker for mode=top, for example "BTC" or "$SOL".

keywords.description: Up to 5 comma separated keywords for mode=search.

accountName.description: X username for mode=search, without the @.

coinIds.description: Comma separated CoinGecko coin ids to filter mode=news.

searchType.description: How multiple keywords combine in mode=search.

from.description: Start of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with to. For mode=search the range must span at least 1 day and at most 30.

to.description: End of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with from.

pageSize.description: Items per page, up to 100. Keep it small and page through rather than asking for everything at once.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous mode=search response.

verbosity.description: concise returns the high signal fields only. Use detailed when you need every metric.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: What is gaining social attention right now. 1 credit per call. scope=tokens returns tickers ranked by mention volume with the change against the previous window. scope=contracts_twitter and scope=contracts_telegram return trending contract addresses.

timeWindow.description: Relative window such as "24h" or "7d". Defaults to 24h unless both from and to are given.

from.description: Start of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with to.

to.description: End of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with from.

pageSize.description: Items per page, up to 100. Keep it small and page through rather than asking for everything at once.

minMentions.description: Drop entries below this mention count.

tools.name: narratives
tools.description: Written narrative analysis with source links, for when counts are not enough. 5 credits per call, so prefer trending or mentions when metrics will do. scope=market extracts the narratives moving the market. scope=keywords summarises events for keywords you supply, and can take over a minute to return.

scope.description: market is a broad sweep. keywords needs the keywords argument.

keywords.description: Up to 5 comma separated keywords for scope=keywords.

searchType.description: How multiple keywords combine for scope=keywords.

maxNarratives.description: Cap the narratives returned for scope=market.

maxTweetsPerNarrative.description: Cap the sources per narrative for scope=market.

from.description: Start of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with to.

to.description: End of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with from.

tools.name: account_stats
tools.description: Smart follower and engagement stats for an X account. 1 credit per call. Use it to judge whether an account's reach is real before weighting what it posts.

username.description: X username, with or without the @.

tools.name: market_chat
tools.description: Ask Elfa for written market analysis grounded in its social data. Costs credits and varies by speed, so fast is the cheaper option. Pass sessionId from a previous reply to continue the same conversation.

analysisType.description: chat needs message. tokenIntro and tokenAnalysis need symbol, or chain plus contractAddress. accountAnalysis needs username. macro and summary need nothing else.

speed.description: Defaults to fast, which is cheaper and shallower. Ask for expert when the answer needs deeper reasoning.

tools.name: auto_build
tools.description: Turn a plain-language monitoring request into an EQL query. Costs 1 credit plus LLM usage. This only drafts the query, nothing starts running until you activate it with auto_query_write. Say what to watch, the threshold, and what should happen when it fires.

message.description: What to monitor, in plain language, for example "tell me on Telegram when BTC funding on Binance goes negative".

speed.description: fast is cheaper, expert reasons more deeply about the query.

sessionId.description: Continue refining a query from an earlier reply.

tools.name: auto_validate
tools.description: Check EQL syntax and get a cost estimate before anything is activated. Free. Always run this before auto_query_write, and show the estimated cost to the user. Pass either an inline query or a draftId. method=symbol instead checks that a symbol has market data on a venue, before you build price or ta conditions around it.

method.description: query validates EQL, symbol checks symbol support.

query.description: EQL query object with conditions, actions and expiresIn. Build it with auto_build and check it with auto_validate first.

draftId.description: Validate a stored draft instead of an inline query.

title.description: Title to validate with the query.

description.description: Description to validate with the query.

tools.name: auto_query
tools.description: Read side of Auto. Free. method=list browses queries, method=get polls one query and returns its latest evaluation, method=executions and method=execution show what fired, method=sessions and method=session return the LLM analysis attached to a query. There is no push channel here, poll with method=get and respect pollAfterSeconds.

queryId.description: Required for get, sessions and session.

limit.description: Page size for list style methods.

tools.name: auto_query_write
tools.description: Activate, cancel or delete an Auto query. Creating costs 5 credits plus LLM usage, cancel and delete are free. An activated query runs unattended and fires its action without asking again, so validate it with auto_validate and confirm the cost and the action with the user before calling this. Queries whose action is not a plain notification also need request signing.

method.description: create activates a new query. cancel stops an active one. delete removes one that has already finished.

query.description: EQL query object with conditions, actions and expiresIn. Build it with auto_build and check it with auto_validate first.

title.description: Short title shown in the notification when this fires.

description.description: Why this was set up, shown alongside the title.

tools.name: auto_draft
tools.description: Park an Auto query without activating it. Drafts never evaluate and never fire. Free, except method=convert which activates the draft and costs the same as creating a query. Use drafts when the user is still deciding.

method.description: upsert creates or updates a draft. convert activates it as a live query.

draftId.description: Required for get, delete and convert. Optional on upsert to update.

query.description: EQL query object with conditions, actions and expiresIn. Build it with auto_build and check it with auto_validate first.

title.description: Title carried into the live query.

description.description: Description carried into the live query.
